notes: Message text follows server I18n (default locale fr).
Attribute validation messages for label are currently English ActiveRecord strings even when flash/auth copy is French.
Friendships 403 uses hardcoded English Forbidden (not French EventTeams flash keys).

error.message: You need to sign in or sign up before continuing.

event_team.unauthenticated.client: Clear JWT and route to sign-in.

event_team.not_viewable.meaning: Event missing or current user cannot view it (private stranger).
event_team.not_viewable.client: Treat as missing; do not distinguish private vs gone.

event_team.not_found.meaning: Team id not on this event.

event_team.roster.team_not_found.meaning: event_team_id missing or not belonging to the event.
event_team.roster.team_not_found.client: Do not treat as empty roster.

event_team.rename.not_participant.meaning: Viewer can see a public event but is not an EventParticipant.

error.message: Seuls les participants peuvent renommer une équipe.
Only participants can rename a team.

event_team.rename.bench.meaning: Bench label is not renameable (countable false).

error.message: Le banc ne peut pas être renommé.

event_team.rename.bench.client: Never show rename CTA for slot bench.

label: Label is too long (maximum is 24 characters)

error.message: You need to sign in or sign up before continuing.

friendship.unauthenticated.client: Clear JWT and route to sign-in.

friendship.target_not_found.meaning: user_id does not match any User (User.find).
friendship.target_not_found.client: Treat as missing user; do not invent a soft-fail empty create.

friendship.forbidden_transition.meaning: Caller is not the receiver, or Friendship is not pending.
friendship.forbidden_transition.client: Hide accept/decline for sender and for non-pending rows.

friendship.forbidden_delete.meaning: Destroy not allowed for this role×status (e.g. receiver+pending, sender+declined).
friendship.forbidden_delete.client: Only offer cancel (sender+pending), unfriend (either+accepted), remove declined (receiver+declined).

friendship.validation.meaning: Self-friend, duplicate directed pair, or reverse pair already exists.

receiver_id: Vous ne pouvez pas vous envoyer une demande d'amitié à vous-même.

base: Une demande d'amitié existe déjà entre ces utilisateurs.

friendship.validation.client: Show message / bind details; do not navigate as success.

friendship.search_empty_query.meaning: Not an HTTP error. Missing or blank q returns [] — never the full user list.
friendship.search_empty_query.client: Do not invent a 422 for empty search; treat as empty results.
